title: G6 sensor - "G5 Sensor Requesting Restart" - now no signal
symptom: G6 sensor after 11 days shows 'G5 sensor requesting restart' and then no readings. Later shows 'sensor stopped' and 'Unusual session start failure, is transmitter crashed? Try Hard Reset?' Hard reset leaves status 'Resetting - please wait' for 10 minutes.
cause: The transmitter has failed, as determined by using the official Dexcom app on an iPhone with a new sensor.
fix: The user resolved the issue by using the official Dexcom app on an iPhone and installing a new sensor, which revealed the transmitter failure. No xDrip-specific fix was provided.
evidence_quote: Having fired up the official dexcom app on an iphone and installed a new sensor, it seems the transmitter has failed - only a month old.
